'''Indrawati Oey''' (born 29 April 1970<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.biw.kuleuven.be/m2s/clmt/lmt/staff_lirias/archive/indrawati-oey |title=Indrawati Oey |website=www.biw.kuleuven.be}}</ref>) is a [[New Zealand]] food scientist, full professor at the [[University of Otago]].<ref name="bio">{{Cite web |url=http://www.otago.ac.nz/food-science/staff/otago081290.html |title=Indrawati Oey |website=www.otago.ac.nz |publisher=University of Otago Department of Food Science |language=en-nz |access-date=2018-02-14}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Oey was born in [[Malang|Malang, East Java, Indonesia]] in 1970.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.biw.kuleuven.be/m2s/clmt/lmt/staff_lirias/archive/indrawati-oey|title=Indrawati Oey|website=www.biw.kuleuven.be|language=en|access-date=2019-05-04}}</ref>

==Academic career==
After a [[PhD]] at [[Katholieke Universiteit Leuven]], Oey moved to the [[University of Otago]] and rose to full professor and head of the Department of Food Sciences.<ref name="bio"/><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.odt.co.nz/news/dunedin/researchers-focus-food-waste |title=Researchers focus on food waste |website=www.odt.co.nz |date=30 January 2012 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.odt.co.nz/news/dunedin/fears-missing-furry-hug-behind-citizenship-decision |title=Fears of missing furry hug behind citizenship decision |website=www.odt.co.nz |date=4 August 2016 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.odt.co.nz/news/dunedin/university-opens-food-research-lab |title=University opens food research lab |website=www.odt.co.nz |date=21 April 2016 }}</ref> She is a principal investigator of the Riddet Institute, a national food research centre in New Zealand.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.riddet.ac.nz/our-people-0|title=Our People {{!}} Riddet Institute|website=www.riddet.ac.nz|access-date=2019-05-03|archive-date=1 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190501161824/http://www.riddet.ac.nz/our-people-0|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Her work has focused on the biochemical reactions that affect multiple aspects of food quality, including texture, flavour, colour, and nutrition.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.scoop.co.nz/stories/AK0907/S00129.htm?FORM=ZZNR6|title=Food quality specialist for Otago professorship|date=July 9, 2009|website=www.scoop.co.nz|access-date=2019-05-04}}</ref> At Otago, she has led a project on applications of pulsed electric field equipment to improve food quality and efficiency of processing.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.newfoodmagazine.com/news/68122/university-new-zealand-pulsed-electric/|title=University in New Zealand starts pulsed electric field French fry experiment|last=Smith|first=George|date=29 June 2018|work=New Food|access-date=2019-05-03}}</ref> She has also worked on edible food packaging to tackle problems of current plastic packaging.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.radionz.co.nz/national/programmes/ourchangingworld/audio/2018647913/edible-bioplastic-food-wrap-of-the-future|title=Edible bioplastic – food wrap of the future?|date=5 June 2018|website=Radio New Zealand|language=en-nz|access-date=2019-05-04}}</ref>

== Honours and awards ==
In 2016 Oey was elected a Fellow of the [[New Zealand Institute of Food Science and Technology]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=NZIFST – List of Fellows |url=https://nzifst.org.nz/page-18126 |access-date=2023-11-12 |website=nzifst.org.nz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Indra Oey |url=https://www.fiet.ac.nz/people/indra-oey/ |access-date=2023-11-12 |website=www.fiet.ac.nz |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Selected works==
* Oey, Indrawati, Martina Lille, Ann Van Loey, and Marc Hendrickx. "Effect of high-pressure processing on colour, texture and flavour of fruit-and vegetable-based food products: a review." [[Trends in Food Science & Technology]] 19, no. 6 (2008): 320–328.
* Oey, Indrawati, Iesel Van der Plancken, Ann Van Loey, and Marc Hendrickx. "Does high pressure processing influence nutritional aspects of plant based food systems?." [[Trends in Food Science & Technology]] 19, no. 6 (2008): 300–308.
* Leong, Sze Ying, and Indrawati Oey. "Effects of processing on anthocyanins, carotenoids and vitamin C in summer fruits and vegetables." [[Food Chemistry (journal)|Food Chemistry]] 133, no. 4 (2012): 1577–1587.
* Verbeyst, Lise, Indrawati Oey, Iesel Van der Plancken, Marc Hendrickx, and Ann Van Loey. "Kinetic study on the thermal and pressure degradation of anthocyanins in strawberries." [[Food Chemistry (journal)|Food Chemistry]] 123, no. 2 (2010): 269–274.
* Van Loey, Ann, V. Ooms, C. Weemaes, Ilse Van den Broeck, Linda Ludikhuyze, Indrawati, S. Denys, and M. Hendrickx. "Thermal and Pressure− Temperature Degradation of Chlorophyll in Broccoli (Brassica oleracea L. italica) Juice: A Kinetic Study." [[Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry]] 46, no. 12 (1998): 5289–5294.
